presets.name: Bare
presets.description: The style at its plainest: the face drawn in black on a white ground. The baseline the rest of these presets move away from.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: Warm all the way through. With no head shape to fill, the background is the paper and the ink is the whole drawing.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: The quietest set here. Nothing competes with the page around it, which suits an admin table or a comment thread where the avatar is a marker rather than a picture.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: Deep teal on mint, two colors total.
presets.description: One teal for the drawing and one pale mint for the ground, and that is the entire palette.

presets.name: Inverted
presets.summary: White line on near black, like chalk.
presets.description: Swaps the two colors. The fill is a color group of its own here, so it goes dark with the ground and the drawing reads as chalk on a board rather than as pale lines dissolving.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Six dusty grounds under the same line.
presets.description: Changes only what the drawing sits on, and away from white rather than towards a brighter color.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Black line on six acid grounds.
presets.description: The other direction: six grounds past anything the style ships, with the line left black so it survives them.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall, strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient under the drawing.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. These styles leave a lot of air around the drawing, and cropping in buys it back.
